server.name: io.github.Nizoka/pdfnative-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDFs. Unset: every tool returns base64 only (file output disabled).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE

environmentVariables.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH

environmentVariables.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: An identity token written by export-identity: brings an existing SAIHM identity to this machine or a hosted agent environment without copying a key file. Set together with SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE; leave both unset to use this machine's own identity.

Defaults to FREE while self-join is on (the default); set it for a paid plan, and with SAIHM_SELF_JOIN=0 for every plan, FREE included. An export-identity token carries its own, which a non-empty value here overrides.
environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_TIER

environmentVariables.description: The payment rail of a paid plan, e.g. stripe. Required for a paid SAIHM_TIER unless an export-identity token carries it.
environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_PAYMENT_METHOD

environmentVariables.description: Set it (e.g. 1) where the home directory is discarded at session end, or is a CI runner's home that later jobs can reach: the join then refuses to create a key, and SAIHM keeps no recall copy and no sign-in there. A copy or sign-in already written there stays until you delete it: the recall.* and session.* files in SAIHM_HOME (~/.saihm by default). 0 declares a home that is kept and that only you use, and overrides the host's own signal. Unset: detected where the host or CI runner says so (the REFERENCE lists the markers).
environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_EPHEMERAL_HOME

environmentVariables.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm. Give a full path: a relative one (a JSON config does not expand ~) is refused at start. Also the fallback state directory when SAIHM_STATE_DIR is unset.

environmentVariables.description: Milliseconds a MongoDB connection may stay unused (no tool call touching it) before it is closed to release the underlying connection pool and its server-side state. environmentVariables.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation. Deprecated: the MCP protocol is moving to sessionless, so this option will soon be removed and the connection scope will default to 'global'. For shared-server use cases, use the Atlas-Managed MCP server or build an authenticated library using the @mongodb-js/mcp-cli package. Note: on the sessionless (2026-07-28) HTTP path, a request without an mcp-session-id falls back to the shared ('global') scope so it can still persist connections across requests; the legacy sessionful path always carries a server-issued session.
environmentVariables.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_SCOPE

environmentVariables.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.
environmentVariables.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING

environmentVariables.description: When set to true, allows binding the HTTP server (and monitoring server) to a non-loopback host such as 0.0.0.0, a LAN IP, or an empty host (all interfaces). With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation. Deprecated: the MCP protocol is moving to sessionless, so this option will soon be removed and the connection scope will default to 'global'. For shared-server use cases, use the Atlas-Managed MCP server or build an authenticated library using the @mongodb-js/mcp-cli package. Note: on the sessionless (2026-07-28) HTTP path, a request without an mcp-session-id falls back to the shared ('global') scope so it can still persist connections across requests; the legacy sessionful path always carries a server-issued session.
